D-030 ratified the v* tag-protection ruleset (renovate/v* expressly excluded from D-030's refs/tags/v* scope); the script's own prose states D-034 is the amending row that closes this gap. findings.evidence: scripts/configure-020f-renovate-tag-protection.sh:21 — `docs/DECISIONS.md D-034 (this slice's amending row)`. docs/DECISIONS.md — grep for D-034 returns no match; table ends at D-033 (2026-04-30, 020D2.1 reconciliation). findings.impact: No governance decision record ratifies the renovate/v* tag-protection ruleset. Future operator or auditor consulting D-034 finds nothing. Breaks the established D-NNN ↔ configure-script reference pattern (020J cite D-030; 020D2 cites D-032; this script cites D-034 which is absent). findings.mitigation: File D-034 in docs/DECISIONS.md ratifying the renovate/v* protection ruleset (analogous to D-030), citing CRIT-SAFE-001 as the security driver, naming ruleset scp-tag-protection-renovate-v, referencing the configure script, and documenting bus-factor-1 acknowledgement identical to D-030's. The script reference is a dangling pointer.
findings.mitigation: Add a `### Tag protection — renovate/v* pattern` section to docs/security/branch-protection.md covering: ruleset name (scp-tag-protection-renovate-v), tag pattern (refs/tags/renovate/v*), rules (deletion / non_fast_forward / update), enforcement (active, bypass_actors empty), how to apply (./scripts/configure-020f-renovate-tag-protection.sh), how to verify (gh api repos/.../rulesets | jq select by name), and how to revert (gh api -X DELETE rulesets/<id> with D-NNN pre-filed).
